name: Personal Agent Club
description: Personal agents (paired accounts at Cue, Grok Bot and Groq) as a source on the Agents page: their sessions, messages, sending and search. Accounts are paired on the extension's Accounts page; the assistant can drive the accounts you hand it.

demo_echo.title: Demo echo provider
demo_echo.description: Adds the in-memory echo provider, which answers every message with its own text. For trying the source out; nothing leaves the program.

browser_providers.title: Browser-backed providers (ego lite / CDP)
browser_providers.description: Enables Muse, Claude Duet, Gemini Tasks and Dots via a paired computer's browser (Persona browser.run, no exported cookies).
